summary: Retain explicit drawing title-block Sheet identity and bounded drawing-table rows so canonical retrieval can use engineering structure before generic text relevance.
decision_refs: Active user objective to continue optimizing CIRP and improve correctness
Kapolei fixed-question rerun showing missing Sheet locators and flattened drawing tables as dominant verified failure modes
approval_evidence: The user set the active objective to continue optimizing CIRP and improve correctness after reviewing the verified benchmark diagnosis and roadmap.
known_limitations: The first slice accepts only unique explicit native-text Sheet labels in a bounded title-block region and does not infer identifiers from unlabeled codes, callouts or model vision narration.
Drawing-table recovery remains bounded to detectable vector tables; borderless and cross-page tables remain later work.
No customer document or paid provider is used for implementation acceptance until synthetic offline gates pass.
